title: Mob Icons+
description: Hostile mobs become easier to recognize at a glance with clean pixel face icons for UI elements, boss bars, and compatible minimaps.
body:
# Mob Icons+

Vanilla-friendly pixel mob face icons for better readability, style, and fun.
![Custom alert icons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe549cc7406dbde2112972f73921fe460db04822.png)

## 👀 What is this?

Mob Icons+ is a resource pack that adds small pixel-style mob face icons.

It is designed to make mobs easier to recognize at a glance while keeping a clean vanilla-friendly look.

## ✨ Features
Readable pixel mob faces
Simple and consistent icon style
Vanilla-friendly look
Great for icon-based UI setups
Designed to stay clear even at small sizes

## 🎯 Goal

This pack is made for players who want icons that are:
useful
recognizable
compact
cute without being too noisy

## 👾 Current mobs

Currently focused on vanilla hostile mobs, including:
Creeper
Enderman
Warden
Skeleton
Spider
Blaze
Witch
and more

## 📌 Style

Each icon is handmade to keep the important visual traits of each mob, even at a very small size.

The goal is not to completely replace Minecraft’s style, but to add a clean pixel-art layer that still feels at home in the game.

## 🚧 Planned updates
Passive mob icons
Neutral mob icons
Boss-focused variants
More compatibility ideas for icon-based UI use

## ❤️ Feedback

If there is a mob you want added or improved, feel free to leave feedback.
